The '''Moonus Mandel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moonus Mandel/Legends|Moonus Mandel]].
